stage.name: 'Eccentricity' Laboratory
stage.description:
Gravity, visibility, trajectory. An arclight builds a bridge at the crossroads of fate, within the erratic everything. Somewhere not far from the land, we shall overcome cowardice and hubris together. We remember, we hold fast, we advance without looking to the past.
<Special Conditions> DP will not regenerate naturally
<Gravity Switch> Gravity Switches and Planetary Debris: Moves along a set path, blocking lanes and dealing physical damage to units they touch. Can be moved by your units in adjacent tiles.

elite_military_hound.name: Elite Military Hound
elite_military_hound.flavourText: Carefully picked military hounds that chase their quarry to the bitter end.

military_hound.name: Military Hound
military_hound.flavourText: Military hounds that first saw action in Bolívar. Their claws and fangs are as vicious as their temperament.

arc_screenguard_captain.name: Arc Screenguard Captain
arc_screenguard_captain.flavourText: Soldiers from an experimental unit with formidable defenses using the most advanced alloy technologies. They don't even need their equipment to hold the frontline and prevent the enemy's advance.
abilities: Starting DEF and RES are high, but reduced whenever damage is taken

arc_commando.name: Arc Commando
arc_commando.flavourText: Soldiers from the experimental unit born of the 'Horizon Arc Project,' able to fly at low altitudes with their jet propulsion equipment.
abilities: If Movement Speed is higher than starting speed, gains Low-Altitude Hovering and takes off!

arc_screenguard.name: Arc Screenguard
arc_screenguard.flavourText: Soldiers from an experimental unit with formidable defenses using the most advanced alloy technologies. However, the unresolved instability of the material makes them better suited for short, high-pressure skirmishes than drawn-out battles.
abilities: Starting DEF and RES are high, but reduced whenever damage is taken

arc_commando_captain.name: Arc Commando Captain
arc_commando_captain.flavourText: Soldiers from the experimental unit born of the 'Horizon Arc Project,' skilled at flying with their jet propulsion equipment. They enjoy the feeling of defying gravity.
abilities: If Movement Speed is higher than starting speed, gains Low-Altitude Hovering and takes off!

trimounts_city_defender.name: Trimounts City Defender
trimounts_city_defender.flavourText: Columbian soldiers stationed in Trimounts. They have close ties to all the tech companies and first dibs on cutting-edge equipment.
abilities: Attacks temporarily inflict -1 Block to allied Operators
If Operator is on a Gravity Switch, reduces their Block to 0

trimounts_city_defender_captain.name: Trimounts City Defender Captain
trimounts_city_defender_captain.flavourText: Columbian soldiers stationed in Trimounts. They have a good understanding of all the tech companies and will choose to fight with their favorite corporation's equipment.
abilities: Attacks temporarily inflict -1 Block to allied Operators
If Operator is on a Gravity Switch, reduces their Block to 0

arc_frontliner_leader.name: Arc Frontliner Leader
arc_frontliner_leader.flavourText: Deadly soldiers from an experimental unit outfitted with highly lethal cutting-edge equipment. A formidable foe even when their gear's weaknesses have been revealed.
abilities: Loses HP proportional to distance moved when shifted

offender_production_model.name: 'Offender' Production Model
offender_production_model.flavourText: Unmanned attack vehicles primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski. Equipped with advanced power units, they assault the enemy with their solid defenses and high speed.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
When passing by an Operator, deals physical damage to them based on Movement Speed

offender_prototype.name: 'Offender' Prototype
offender_prototype.flavourText: Unmanned attack vehicles primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski. Equipped with advanced power units, they fiercely assault the enemy with their solid defenses and high speed.
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
When passing by an Operator, deals physical damage to them based on Movement Speed

arc_frontliner.name: Arc Frontliner
arc_frontliner.flavourText: Deadly soldiers from an experimental unit outfitted with cutting-edge equipment. However, the instability of their gear is their weak spot.
abilities: Loses HP proportional to distance moved when shifted

crossroads_production_model.name: 'Crossroads' Production Model
crossroads_production_model.flavourText: Unmanned defense vehicles primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski. They emit mid-length lasers in all four directions, providing excellent defense in narrow corridors, and significantly hindering the enemy even in open terrain.
abilities: Attacks in 4 directions while moving, dealing Arts damage and deals increased damage to nearby targets
Continuously tries to push nearby <Planetary Debris>

crossroads_prototype.name: 'Crossroads' Prototype
crossroads_prototype.flavourText: Unmanned defense vehicles primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski. They emit intense mid-length lasers in all four directions, providing first-class defense in narrow corridors, and dramatically hindering the enemy even in open terrain.
abilities: Attacks in 4 directions while moving, dealing Arts damage and deals increased damage to nearby targets
Continuously tries to push nearby <Planetary Debris>

traffic_tower_prototype.name: 'Traffic Tower' Prototype
traffic_tower_prototype.flavourText: A robot primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski, the crystallization of cutting-edge advances in every field. If they could lower the cost of production to make it feasible for mass-production, perhaps it could even change the nature of warfare.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 4 Block
DEF and RES is reduced whenever damage is taken
When destroyed, ejects a <'Traffic Officer Captain'> and self-destructs, dealing physical damage to nearby units

traffic_tower_production_model.name: 'Traffic Tower' Production Model
traffic_tower_production_model.flavourText: A robot primarily developed by Volvort Kochinski, the crystallization of cutting-edge advances in every field. Volvort Kochinski wanted to use this design to win back the DOD's favor, but it was overshadowed by the Galleria Stellaria.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 4 Block
DEF and RES is reduced whenever damage is taken
When destroyed, ejects a <'Traffic Officer'> and self-destructs, dealing physical damage to nearby units
